meta.scoring: Each part is scaled 0 to 1 across the ranked neighborhoods (between the 5th and 95th percentile, so one extreme place does not flatten the rest). A measure is the weighted mean of its known parts. The score is the weighted mean of the known measures, times 100: a missing measure earns nothing and costs nothing.

template_prices.scan_rule: a price not ending in 0 or 5 shared by 6+ listings at 4+ addresses in one neighborhood

zumper_no_pets_block.finding: a real statement by the lister, not a site default

sensitivity.note: rank under each weight x1.5 and x0.5 and under equal weights; rank_range is the lowest and highest of these

tag_floors.near family: drive to Mom and Dad of 30 minutes or less
tag_floors.lively: 20 or more restaurants, bars and cafés within a 10-minute walk
tag_floors.quiet: 5 or fewer restaurants, bars and cafés within a 10-minute walk
tag_floors.more room: median stated size of 650 sq ft or more (at least 5 listings state a size)
tag_floors.good value: median listed rent of $1,700 or less
tag_floors.easy parking: off-street parking at more than half of the buildings that describe parking (at least 5 do)
tag_floors.dog friendly: at least half of the listings say dogs are allowed
tag_floors.lots of choice: 40 or more apartments listed at $2,000 or less

meta.know_this_rule: a measure in the bottom 40% of the ranked list whose own figure is worse than the list's median; none when nothing qualifies
meta.confidence_rule: high: rank range 12 or narrower and 30+ listings; low: range wider than 40 or under 15 listings; otherwise medium
not_measured: Listing descriptions are not held in the listings table, so repeated template text is not tested.
Going out and green come from the neighborhood record, measured at the buildings that passed the earlier checks.
Overnight street parking is known only for the towns whose rules were read.

neighborhoods.name: Newark
neighborhoods.typical_rent_note: middle listed rent of the studios and one-bedrooms at $2,000 or less

why.text: Half of the studios and one-bedrooms listed here ask $1,600 or less in rent, and 430 are listed at $2,000 or less.
A park is about 4 minutes away on foot, and the nearest dog run is 1.3 miles away.
About 10 restaurants, bars and cafés are within a 10-minute walk of a typical building here.

life_here.fact: Military Park is a six-acre triangle downtown with the Wars of America monument by the sculptor of Mount Rushmore, Gutzon Borglum.
Newark Symphony Hall, the city's 'first stage', opened in 1925 and is in the middle of a large restoration.
Newark sits in the first county park system in the United States, created in 1895; Branch Brook, at about 360 acres, is the largest of its parks.
life_here.source_name: Essex County, press release on the Branch Brook Dog Park

life_here.fact: Riverfront Park on the Passaic, first opened in 2013, now stretches to NJPAC; its newest section, "The Notch", opened in October 2024.
life_here.source_name: Newark City Parks Foundation, Riverfront Park

Apartments that state a size run about 750 square feet (the middle of 64 listings).
Of 151 listings here, 84 say dogs are allowed, 7 more say pets are allowed without naming dogs, and 17 state an elevator or a second-floor apartment.

life_here.place: Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park
life_here.fact: The Great Falls of the Passaic are a national historical park inside the city; the grounds are open every day, with no visitor center or indoor facilities.
life_here.source_name: National Park Service, Paterson Great Falls: Basic Information

life_here.fact: Hinchliffe Stadium, by the falls, is a 7,800-seat National Historic Landmark built in 1932 and one of four remaining Negro League ballparks.
life_here.source_name: New Jersey Jackals (team site), March 2026 announcement

neighborhoods.name: Bayonne
neighborhoods.typical_rent_note: middle listed rent of the studios and one-bedrooms at $2,000 or less

why.text: Half of the studios and one-bedrooms listed here ask $1,700 or less in rent, and 162 are listed at $2,000 or less.
A park is about 6 minutes away on foot, and the nearest dog run is 1.1 miles away.
Mom and Dad are about 46 minutes away by car; two visits a month comes to about 3.0 hours of driving and $55 in tolls.

know_this.text: 12 of the 23 buildings that describe parking have a garage, a lot or another space off the street; overnight street parking needs a permit here.
There are few places to eat and drink nearby: about 2 restaurants, bars and cafés within a 10-minute walk.

overnight_parking.text: Overnight street parking needs a permit here.

life_here.fact: Broadway is Bayonne's main street; about two-thirds of the places in the city's 2026 dining guide have a Broadway address.

why.text: Half of the studios and one-bedrooms listed here ask $1,608 or less in rent, and 16 are listed at $2,000 or less.
5 of the 5 buildings that describe parking have a garage, a lot or another space off the street.
Of 18 listings here, 7 say dogs are allowed, 0 more say pets are allowed without naming dogs, and 4 state an elevator or a second-floor apartment.

know_this.text: The nearest park is a long walk: about 15 minutes on foot.
It is far from Mom and Dad: about 104 minutes by car; two visits a month comes to about 7.0 hours of driving and $33 in tolls.

life_here.fact: Downtown Seymour has brick sidewalks, old-fashioned street lamps and Victorian "painted ladies" on a bend of the Naugatuck River.
Seymour grew around David Humphreys' 1804 mill, which made the first American-made woolen cloth; the town took its name in 1850.
